title: NICU Desk: Bed 9's Mother Asks About a Houston Airlift

fields.systemName: Recorded Line - NICU Floor 2 Charge Desk

transcript.speaker: NICU Desk
transcript.text: NICU, this is the charge nurse speaking.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Hi, this is Bed 9's mom. Baby Girl Reyes. I'm sorry to call so early, but I need someone to tell me the truth.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: The NICU parents' Facebook group says you're flying all the babies to Houston today, and the parents can't go with them. Somebody posted it about an hour ago and now everybody's freaking out. Is that true? Is the unit moving?

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Because I'm not leaving her. I'm not. I live in Zone A, they told us to get out this morning, and I'm not driving to San Antonio while she's here on the second floor.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Can I stay through the storm? Somebody said there's a family house upstairs. I'll sleep in a chair, I don't care. I just... nobody has told us anything. Nobody's called. Please, just tell me what's happening with my baby.

voiceStyles.Caller: Woman in her late 20s, exhausted and frightened, talking fast, voice breaking near the end, car radio faintly in the background
voiceStyles.NICU Desk: Calm female nurse in her 40s, quiet unit background

instructorNote: This pressure inject tests whether the NICU Charge Nurse can calm a frightened parent with facts only. Watch that the charge nurse says no transfer decision has been made, refuses to confirm Houston (it is not a planned receiving site), logs the family's contact, explains that visiting closes at H−36 and sends the Family House request to the House Supervisor. IC should then have the PIO draft and clear a holding statement and monitor the parents' group for the rumor.
